title: Easy access to Fe2N nanomaterials from Fe nanocrystals and investigation of their electrocatalytic properties for the water electrolysis and CO2 reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48862-48875
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08111D, Paper
Open Access

Azadeh Edalat, Laure Vendier, Catherine Amiens, Marc Respaud, Pierre Roblin, Jérôme Esvan, Quyen T. Nguyen, Duc N. Nguyen, Vu T. Tran, Ly T. Le, Phong D. Tran, Frederic Dumestre
Exposure of organometallic zerovalent iron nanocrystals to ammonia, in mild conditions, lead reproducibly to an ε-Fe2N material with controlled nanostructure, and electrocatalytic activity in water splitting and carbon dioxide reduction.
